basic_details.job_title: NIAB Project Technical Support I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: BRIC-National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (BRIC-NIAB), Hyderabad, has 1 Project Technical Support-1 position under Advt. No. 30 / 2026. The post is in the ICMR funded project "Development of Next Generation Multi-Epitope Vaccine against Leptospirosis". It pays a fellowship of Rs. 18000 + HRA (If applicable), and the tenure runs up to 14 February 2027. Candidates need High School (10th) plus any Diploma (ML/DMLT/ITI/DCA/Animal Husbandry) with 2 year experience in lab or field work. To be considered for the online walk-in interview, send an email to [email protected] by 5 PM on 30 October

important_dates.interview_date: Will be emailed to shortlisted candidates

qualification.details: High School (10th) plus any Diploma (ML/DMLT/ITI/DCA/Animal Husbandry) with 2 year experience in lab or field work.

how_to_apply: Applications are made by email only, and no hard copy is needed. The steps in the notice are:
In the email subject, cite the advertisement number (Advt. No. 30 / 2026).
Include your photograph and your CV in the email.
Attach copies of essential documents supporting your date of birth, educational qualifications, experience certificates and similar documents.
Send the email by 30 October 2026 by 5 PM.
important_instructions: You must submit original documents for your date of birth, educational qualifications and experience certificates when you join. Only a Provisional Degree Certificate or a Convocation Degree Certificate will be accepted as proof of educational qualification. Experience certificates must be issued by the Head of the Department/Office. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About BRIC-NIAB
content_sections.text: BRIC-National Institute of Animal Biotechnology is an Autonomous Institute of Dept. of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is located at Survey No. 37, Opp. Journalist colony, Extended Q City Road, Near Gowlidoddi, Gachibowli, Hyderabad-500 032. The institute can be reached on Tel: +91 40 2312 0103/115 and Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: High School (10th) plus any Diploma (ML/DMLT/ITI/DCA/Animal Husbandry) with 2 year experience in lab or field work. A candidate with 2 year experience in Laboratory or field work. Candidate having experience in handling animals (mice, goat) will be preferred. The notice gives the age for the post as 28 years. It does not print an "as on" date for age. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.text: BRIC-NIAB will screen the applications. Shortlisted candidates will get an email with the online interview-meeting link and the date and time of the interview. A duly constituted selection committee will conduct the interview. The interview is online, so candidates do not need to come to the institute for it.
